metrics.counting: Only unique full-analysis product paragraphs count toward body gates; summaries, captions, coverage and sources excluded.

topics.enHeadline: AgentValley gives waiting agents distinct voices and a choice of display
topics.evidence: confirmed product documentation; vendor claims, no editorial runtime test
topics.eventDateNote: Changelog day precision. GitHub release page displays Oct24 04:17/05:14/08:12/14:25 without explicit timezone in extracted text; no UTC conversion asserted.
topics.delta_since_last_seen: October 24 updates add distinct audible cues for requests and completion, plus a choice of external display. It does not supply a new coding model.

topics.zhHeadline: 笔记熊把录音按人和项目关联，下次开会前找回决定与待办

topics.eventDateNote: Confirmed event day; prior event invitation scheduled October24 11:00 Beijing (03:00Z), actual on-stage clock not independently verified. Source publication at18:53:48 is not launch time.
topics.delta_since_last_seen: A pre-meeting review brings together earlier discussions, changed budgets and unfinished work, reducing the need to reopen separate notes. New information updates earlier conclusions.

topics.zhHeadline: HomeSurvey把眼镜拍到的家具整理成搬家清单，报价前仍能逐件改

topics.evidence: confirmed product documentation; vendor engineering disclosure, not independent test
topics.eventDateNote: Official page says launched at IAM2026 and identifies October21–24 booth dates; exact first-availability clock not stated. Conservative seven-day event interval, not October24 launch.
topics.delta_since_last_seen: The new capture route reuses the existing phone-video pipeline, rather than measuring rooms live inside the glasses. Recording frees the hands; upload and quote review remain.

topics.eventDateNote: day precision; exact publication clock not given

topics.delta_since_last_seen: During recording, Guardian can flag signs of escalation; a human reviews the livestream and decides whether support is needed.

topics.evidence: Original maintainer release, implementation and documentation; no editorial runtime test
topics.eventDateNote: second
topics.delta_since_last_seen: The .ifpkg export moves supported agents, skills and files together, recreating their references in the destination workspace instead of requiring separate transfers. Explicit YAML export remains, and missing resources are reported during import.

topics.zhHeadline: Kimi K3.1 Pro保留工具调用上下文，长任务接入要改的不只是模型名
topics.enHeadline: Kimi K3.1 Pro keeps tool context intact across a long task
topics.evidence: Official release and implementation documentation; not independent model evaluation
topics.eventDateNote: Official forum displayed October23 8:12pm without timezone; do not convert to UTC. Chinese reporting describes October24 early morning. Recent72h supplement.
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Reasoning stays enabled, with low, high or max effort. Streaming reasoning and final output are separate, so retaining only visible text loses required state.

topics.zhHeadline: capy-flash让长对话读回磁盘缓存，重启后少算一遍上下文

topics.evidence: Original maintainer release, implementation and documentation; no editorial runtime test
topics.eventDateNote: second
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Version 0.7.4 fixes long-history and single-GPU disk restoration; 0.7.5 adds optional CPU and PCIe calibration for splitting missed experts.

topics.zhHeadline: ADK把语音拆成可替换三段，插话后只保留已播放的话
topics.enHeadline: ADK separates speech stages and trims interrupted playback history
topics.evidence: Original maintainer release, implementation and documentation; no editorial runtime test
topics.eventDateNote: second
topics.delta_since_last_seen: When the user speaks, the connection cancels reasoning and synthesis, tells the client to stop playback and trims history against the audio timeline.

topics.zhHeadline: Pydantic AI把引用接到具体文字，换前端后仍能带回来源

topics.evidence: Original maintainer release, implementation and documentation; no editorial runtime test
topics.eventDateNote: second
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Applications need less provider-specific parsing, although citations can arrive after their text. The completed response is the reliable place to collect them. Original provider fields remain available, and merged text parts require shifted citation anchors.

topics.zhHeadline: Agent Framework要求先划定会话归属，多次审批的结果也要完整留下

topics.eventDateNote: second
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Results from separately submitted approvals are retained in persisted snapshots in call order, avoiding incomplete history when the next turn begins.

topics.zhHeadline: LangGraph让应用按线程分配优先级，排队规则不必藏在提示词里
topics.enHeadline: LangGraph assigns thread priority through application policy
topics.evidence: Original maintainer release, implementation and documentation; no editorial runtime test
topics.eventDateNote: second
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Later runs reuse those settings. Priority, group and weight can be specified separately, with defaults for omitted fields. New threads can have no identifier yet, so the policy must handle that case.

topics.zhHeadline: Vercel AI SDK只解析最后一份正式JSON，保留此前回答供追踪

topics.eventDateNote: second
topics.delta_since_last_seen: The parsed object supports application work while complete text, annotations, message history and token usage remain available to explain the actual response.

topics.evidence: research signal; author experiments, no independent reproduction
topics.eventDateNote: second precision arXiv submission; public announcement time unconfirmed
topics.delta_since_last_seen: Fluent interpretation amplifies both correct and incorrect history. Separating evidence status reduces harmful answer changes in the benchmark. The experiment changes stored text, rather than the underlying camera or eye-tracking hardware.
